_comment: Section-scoped analyte-name aliases. Some IDEXX report layouts wrap a long analyte name across two lines, which the parser emits as truncated/fragmented names (e.g. 'Blood /' + 'Hemoglobin' for 'Blood / Hemoglobin', or 'White Blood' + 'Cells'). Each rule below maps a confirmed-identical variant ('from') to its canonical name ('to') WITHIN a section, so the catalog and trend series unify instead of showing duplicate/empty cards. Applied at the catalog/aggregation layer only — per-report parse output is left untouched. Note: 'Cells' alone is intentionally NOT aliased because it is ambiguous (it pairs with 'White Blood' in some reports and 'Red Blood' in others); disambiguating it requires a parser-level name-stitch, not a static alias.
